title: Budget ledger schemas
responsibility: Defines the validated performance baselines and reviewed baseline or approval events stored in the budget ledger.

outputs.name: performanceBaselineSchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod schema for a numeric performance baseline with nonempty workload, metric, profile, unit and method, a supported runtime target and complete comparison context.

outputs.name: budgetEventSchema
outputs.description: Zod union of strict baseline and approval records. Both name a unit, verification record, reviewer, reason, time and performance baselines; baseline stores metrics, approval stores before and after limits, and either may explain unmeasured metrics.
